messages.subject: R devel issue: no slot of name "generator" for this object of class "refObjectGenerator"
parts:
FYI, with R Under development (unstable) (2012-11-01 r61067), I get an error that I think is related to recent updates on S4 in R devel, e.g.

"setRefClass() and getRefClass() now return class generator functions, similar to setClass(), but still with the reference fields and methods as before (suggestion of Romain Francois)." [http://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/NEWS.R-devel.html]

I post it here, in case it's something that ggplot2 is doing incorrectly (although I don't think so).  If not, feel free to report/forward this to the R devel mailing list.

REPRODUCIBLE EXAMPLE:

> library(ggplot2)
> example(ggplot)
ggplot> df <- data.frame(gp = factor(rep(letters[1:3], each = 10)),
ggplot+                  y = rnorm(30))
ggplot> # Compute sample mean and standard deviation in each group
ggplot> library(plyr)
ggplot> ds <- ddply(df, .(gp), summarise, mean = mean(y), sd = sd(y))
ggplot> # Declare the data frame and common aesthetics.
ggplot> # The summary data frame ds is used to plot
ggplot> # larger red points in a second geom_point() layer.
ggplot> # If the data = argument is not specified, it uses the
ggplot> # declared data frame from ggplot(); ditto for the aesthetics.
ggplot> ggplot(df, aes(x = gp, y = y)) +
ggplot+    geom_point() +
ggplot+    geom_point(data = ds, aes(y = mean),
ggplot+               colour = 'red', size = 3)
